name: CP-132,484
summary: CP-132,484, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-1-methyltryptamine (4,5-DHP-1-Me-T), is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors. It has reasonable selectivity for 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C subtypes over 5-HT2B, but is only slightly selective for 5-HT2A over 5-HT2C.

pharmacology.text: CP-132,484, also known as 4,5-dihydropyrano-1-methyltryptamine (4,5-DHP-1-Me-T), is a tryptamine derivative which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors.

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study 5-HT2 serotonin receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用於研究 5-HT2 血清素受體的研究化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用于研究 5-HT2 血清素受体的研究化合物，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: The CP in its name marks it as a Pfizer research compound. Its extra pyran ring locks part of the tryptamine in place, a trick chemists use to find out which shape a receptor prefers.
fact.zh: 名稱中的 CP 表示這是輝瑞的研究化合物。它多出來的吡喃環把色胺的一部分固定住，化學家用這種方法來找出受體偏好的形狀。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的 CP 表示这是辉瑞的研究化合物。它多出来的吡喃环把色胺的一部分固定住，化学家用这种方法来找出受体偏好的形状。
